modules.why: the engine: runs every finding class's declared contract on canonical parsers (tree-sitter, yaml, smol-toml, jsonc-parser, git); two small readers remain in code because no canonical library exists in the repository for them: the RFC 6901 decoding of a bind pointer (~1, ~0: two replacements; node_modules holds jsonc-parser, yaml and smol-toml, whose paths are key arrays, not pointer strings, and no JSON Pointer package; @saasreport/core stays dependency-free for Workers) and the ${{ }} expressions of a workflow, which are not parsed at all: the contracts name the one declared form as an exact const (${{ matrix.runner }}, ${{ matrix.canary }}) and refuse every other expression, and a single containment pattern routes the message (no GitHub expression parser or actionlint in the repository)
runs a class's detectors and proves its cases; the git facts it hands the engine are read by git itself
the canon runner: validates kit.canon.json against its schema and dispatches the declared checks

A generic evaluator for the machine-readable kit.capability-manifest.v1 contract, invoked by the existing check contracts engine: contract-described paths, OpenAPI operation IDs, generated Forge SDK and Widget parity, failure evidence, and promotion gates. No project-specific hand-written rule is allowed; rules live in JSON Schema and the capability registry.
file walking and globs (node:path matchesGlob) for every check
